conf_observation.counter_scope: boot; delta between BLESVC reply snapshots, not exact capture
conf_observation.interpretation: No delivered CONF error status observed in this window. All events were unmatched to an active indication waiter; this is not proof of FAST classification, origin epoch, central acknowledgement or application receipt.
conf_observation.one_event_ahead: After snapshot has active1, started17081, completed17080, confOk17081. The SDK callback can execute before the BLE owner publishes SDK-return completion. This is consistent with the one in-flight call and is not an anomalous extra event; no unique event/call ID proves individual pairing.

comparison.arithmetic_limit: Not measured RF capacity and not a proposal to remove LOG. All science records require3D notifications in these captures.
comparison.causality_limit: Separate boots/windows; SDK wall is elapsed time including possible blocking/preemption, not CPU time. Counters at different query/log times are not exactly additive to capture loss.

confirmed_findings: screen06 observed BUILD is0c94fe3-dirty and ELF SHA3077bfbfb35d7f90e27e15673ab90f90c35243db97ec0259776ecd84db019f97; this device reply identifies the measured image rather than current working-tree HEAD.
confError delta0 narrows the failure: no error-status CONF callback was observed. Immediate SDK errors/legacy fe are also0, but none of those counts proves end-to-end PC delivery.
CONF count exceeds completed SDK-call count by1 only at the after snapshot; started exceeds completed by1 and active is1. Do not flag this asynchronously valid ordering as duplicate completion.
Both screens retain negotiated7.5ms/2MPHY/MTU247. Three DATA notifications per scientific frame and current notification service remain insufficient for the source rate.
BLE admission drops remain the largest observed loss layer. Transport drops and output/USB differences remain separately reported in their actual windows, not a single invented total.
ADC runtime CRC counter delta remains0 in screen06. BLE throughput remains inadequate; this observation patch is not a throughput repair.

WorkBudget quantum/backstop reasons can overlap. No CPU owner runtime or HCI-credit series exists in this capture, so neither SDK wall nor idleChanged0 assigns the remaining time to CPU or a specific wait.

source_ordering_evidence.ordering: Call start/active is published under mux before esp_ble_gatts_send_indicate; completion is published after return. The independent CONF callback increments its counters under the same mux. Atomic snapshot prevents torn counters, not asynchronous phase differences.

limits: No production/SDK/config edits; no target build or hardware access.
CONF matching means only waiter predicate, not proven callback connection epoch; all screen06 observed events are unmatched.
Host notification timestamps include BlueZ/DBus/Python delivery and cannot identify RF event boundaries.
Query and debug timestamps are receipt windows, not exact conversion/frame timestamps.
No claim of improved BLE throughput or completed acceptance.
